mod.help: Settings for the Auto Regen mod.

tick.title: Per Tick
tick.help: Restore HP, FP and SP over time.

hit.title: Per Hit
hit.help: Restore HP, FP and SP when you land a hit.

tick_enabled.label: Enabled
tick_enabled.help: Turns regeneration over time on or off.

when.label: When
when.help: When it applies. During gesture uses the gesture list in the config file.

interval.label: Interval (ms)
interval.help: How often it restores, in milliseconds (1000 = 1 second). 0 turns it off. Shorter is smoother but costs a little more.

value_type.label: Value Type
value_type.help: What the amounts below mean: points, percent of max, or percent of what is missing.

tick_hp.label: HP
tick_hp.help: HP restored each interval, in the unit chosen above.

tick_fp.label: FP
tick_fp.help: FP restored each interval, in the unit chosen above.

tick_sp.label: SP
tick_sp.help: SP restored each interval, in the unit chosen above.

max_fill.label: Max Fill
max_fill.help: Regeneration stops at this percent of the maximum. 100 means no limit.

hit_enabled.label: Enabled
hit_enabled.help: Turns regeneration on hit on or off.

mode.label: Mode
mode.help: What the amounts below mean: points, percent of max, or percent of the damage you dealt.

skip_aow.label: Skip Ash of War
skip_aow.help: Hits from an Ash of War restore nothing.

hit_hp.label: HP
hit_hp.help: HP restored per hit, in the unit chosen above.

hit_fp.label: FP
hit_fp.help: FP restored per hit, in the unit chosen above.

hit_sp.label: SP
hit_sp.help: SP restored per hit, in the unit chosen above.

log.label: Log file
log.help: Write a log file next to the DLL, for troubleshooting.
